infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KidSketch needs access to the camera so your child can turn their photos into coloring pages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KidSketch needs access to your photo library so you can pick a photo to transform into a coloring page.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: KidSketch saves finished coloring pages to your photo library so you can print or share them.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow KidSketch to use your camera to capture photos for coloring pages.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow KidSketch to access your photos to create coloring pages.
Allow KidSketch to save coloring pages to your photo library.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow KidSketch to save finished artwork to your photo library.
